authorized_scope: Roadmap steps 1-2: staged request preparation and pinned scheduled evaluation; no runtime activation or later worker/HTTP rollout

implementation.P1: Bounded all-or-nothing object batches, detached model/payload data, UseNumber, exact object IDs, source-compatible independent repeated-ID items, explicit stored-record validation.
implementation.P2: Authorized current request selection or actual scheduled owner at expected tenant/running attempt/generation; read its immutable committed iteration/rules, not current live-cache selection.
implementation.P3: Fresh model resolution, bounded typed metadata, static boolean AST/type checks, actual published trigger/aggregate registry and SQL compiler checks; closed/stale/missing contracts fail closed.
implementation.P4: Real shared evaluator and local persistence body produce opaque single-use prepared outputs before any writes. Per-item caches prevent cross-item payload/history contamination. No transaction manager call during preparation.
implementation.P5: Pure, real MySQL, source PostgreSQL service regressions, affected vet and complete-module compilation passed; larger release/provider acceptance remains separate.

contracts.admission: PrepareRequest is read-only evidence, NOT durable owner/job creation. Creation must recheck current identity/live/model bindings in its own transaction. No-scenario requests prepare payload/model only; all-live scenario selection remains execution-time.
contracts.scheduled_pinning: Pins iteration trigger formula/rules/thresholds. It does not freeze every mutable scenario parent setting, workflow routing or the data model. Parent trigger object type and historical reads retain existing current-state semantics; explicit item types/formulas must validate against the current published model.
contracts.consistency: Short authorized READ COMMITTED metadata operation allows identity locks; selected committed content is immutable. No provider/network IO while holding that transaction. Registry queries recheck their gates individually; no global historical-data snapshot is claimed.
contracts.candidates: Explicit items or source-style candidate selection; default min(100, configured item bound). Explicit over-budget limits fail rather than silently clamp. Empty candidate set is valid. Missing/invalid records are not silently skipped.
contracts.persistence: PreparedScheduled.PersistAll performs local SQL on the caller's decision mutation contract and returns provisional results. Step-3 worker composition must bind its prepared identity to the actual lease and call whole-batch fenced completion. No commit or owner acknowledgement is performed by preparation itself.
contracts.recovery: Single-use plans must not be blindly replayed after rollback or uncertain commit. Reconcile and reprepare. Full worker/commit-recovery composition remains the next roadmap stage.

source_attestation.method: SHA-256 of sorted per-file SHA-256 manifest for every Go/SQL/go.mod/go.sum under decision-engine-service, mysqlstore, investigator and data-model-service; identical relative paths on host and copied runner.
source_attestation.source_inventory: Explicit disposable PostgreSQL regeneration reviewed: two new service-file hashes, changed decision/object-preparation hashes and one line reference. Catalog and target schema mapping unchanged; source inventory now 162 files.
